/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/0/items.source_en: The route is built around a 17:00 return to the terminal you were collected from — eight hours after a 09:00 pickup, which leaves a comfortable buffer before the all-aboard times most Busan port calls use. If your ship sails unusually early, the guide adjusts the running order on the day.

No subway transfers, no city-hotel transfers — you are collected at the cruise terminal arrival hall at 09:00 and dropped back at the same point at about 17:00. Which of the two Busan cruise terminals applies to you depends on where your ship berths, and is confirmed at booking.

/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/1/items.source_en: Jagalchi → ⟦G1⟧ → ⟦G0⟧ sit within 600 m of each other in Nampo-dong; the bus tour walks the cluster end-to-end (only the coach repositions for pickup), saving 30+ min of would-be coach time and giving the day three substantive stops where a less-efficient route would fit only one.
Gamcheon at golden hour by design

Gamcheon gets 45 minutes in the early afternoon, once the morning tour groups have cleared the observation deck. Placing it after the Nampo-dong markets means the walk runs downhill through the painted lanes rather than up them.

Yongdusan is the day's closing stop because it sits directly above the Nampo-dong streets you walked earlier — the last twenty minutes reframe the whole afternoon from above, and the terminal is a short drive from the same pickup point.

/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/2/items.source_en: This is the budget product. The coach is shared with other cruise passengers from multiple ships; pickup/drop is at the terminal coach lot, not directly at your ship's gangway. Guests wanting a small-van experience (≈12 max), longer stop times at each attraction, and possible itinerary tweaks should book our small-group Busan cruise tour at the higher price point.

The 20–50 minute stop windows are fixed across the group. You can choose what to do inside a stop — ride the Songdo cable car up to Sky Park or walk the free skywalk instead, go up the Busan Diamond Tower or stay at park level — but you cannot lengthen a stop or drop one. Guests who want the day reshaped around them should take the private charter.
Cable car and tower observatory not included

Songdo Marine Cable Car (₩17,000 adult round-trip) and the Busan Diamond Tower observatory (₩12,000) are not in the tour price. The cable car is an on-site choice at the Songdo stop: ride it up to Sky Park, or stay at sea level and walk the free Cloud Trails skywalk instead.

/routeShapeIntro/subtitle.source_en: Cruise terminal pickup at 09:00; northeast to ⟦G1⟧ first, while the cliff is still quiet; back across the city for the ⟦G0⟧ and lunch at your own expense; then Nampo-dong walked end to end as three separate stops (Jagalchi, ⟦G4⟧, ⟦G3⟧); Gamcheon's painted hillside; Songdo for the Cloud Trails skywalk and, if you take the cable car, Sky Park across the bay; ⟦G2⟧ last, and back at your terminal by 17:00.
/routeShapeIntro/subtitle.tm: Prelievo al terminal crociere alle 09:00; prima verso nord-est a ⟦G1⟧, quando la scogliera è ancora tranquilla; poi di nuovo attraverso la città per il ⟦G0⟧ e il pranzo a Suo carico; quindi Nampo-dong percorsa a piedi da un capo all’altro, come tre tappe distinte (il Mercato Jagalchi, la ⟦G4⟧, il ⟦G3⟧); la collina dipinta di Gamcheon; Songdo per la passerella Cloud Trails e, se prende la funivia, lo Sky Park dall’altra parte della baia; per ultimo il ⟦G2⟧, e rientro al Suo terminal entro le 17:00.
